title: The Vampire's new skill trees
changes: The Vampire's three trees now have 7 skills each, with new ones: Blood Lance, Sanguine Ward, Charm, Rat Plague, Native Soil and The Brides.
Exsanguinate now reaches a wide circle and bursts every bleed at once. Blood Link can carry your blood to a group ally, and Blood Pact saves you from one killing blow every 3 minutes.
Mist Form goes much further, Bat Swarm leaves a shield of bats, Night Pounce steps out behind your prey, and Thirst is shared with your group.
Cloak of Night and Blood Frenzy are gone: points spent on them move to Rat Plague and The Brides.
